content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I created a web server for [product_name] [version_no] and it operates well, but I'm only able to monitor values, not modify them. Also, I can only log in when on the same network—attempts to access it from other networks fail.

Hello, To enable changing values via the web server, you need to permit parameter modifications from a function block. - Verify in the function block settings that the protection option is not enabled (this restricts editing values in parameter mode). - Check message text properties to confirm the parameter can be changed within parameter mode. For VM-Memory value changes, use the variable table on the web server, enter the VM address, and adjust the value as required. If you have multiple [product_name] [version_no] units on the network and can't connect, check: - Same subnet: Ensure the IP configuration is correct. - Different subnet: Validate the subnet setup. Attached is an example showing protection differences and VW0 variable modification via the web server. Hope this assists.
Thank you for your support. Is it possible to force an input or output value? I can't seem to locate a protection checkbox for inputs or outputs.

analysis.insight_summary: Users can set up and monitor their web server for [product_name] [version_no], but face two main issues: the inability to adjust values using the web interface and difficulty accessing the server remotely from outside the local network. Parameter modification options are not clearly available for all item types (such as inputs and outputs), which leads to confusion. Additionally, network configuration issues prevent remote connections.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to be able to change values on [product_name] [version_no] through the web server interface and remotely connect from other networks without complex configuration hurdles.
pain_keywords: inability to modify via web server
